Manifest.Name: Eleanor Story Expand / 上层区的富家千金爱上在下层区开当铺的我：埃莉诺剧情扩展
Manifest.Author: EleanorRomance Team
Manifest.Description: 1.17 adds conservative cross-mod compatibility: the bail officer and freed visit use private er_story_* identifiers, so another Eleanor mod that blocks or purges vanilla eleanor* clients cannot remove our rescue event, and the rescue is queued from our own daily hook instead of the vanilla scheduler. It also preserves another mod's native-key Eleanor portraits and re-asserts our fixed prelude bracelet price after other price patches. The 1.16 gala portrait fix, 1.15 two-person speaker/harem date fixes, 1.14 game-version policy, 1.13 mother trade/bail fixes, 1.12 bracelet fix and earlier fixes remain. Simplified Chinese / English. 1.17 增加保守的跨 MOD 兼容：保释官与释放来访改用本 MOD 私有的 er_story_* 编号，其他埃莉诺 MOD 即使屏蔽或清理原版 eleanor* 客户也关不掉我们的救援事件；救援改由本 MOD 每日钩子排队，不依赖原版调度。同时保留其他 MOD 使用原版键的埃莉诺立绘，并在其他价格补丁之后重申前章手镯固定价。保留 1.16 晚会立绘修复、1.15 双人演出名字与后宫约会日修复、1.14 游戏版本策略、1.13 母亲交易与保释修复、1.12 手镯修复及更早修复。简体中文 / English。
